sentence: This project studies how plant roots and soil microbes interact and how invasive insects affect forest biodiversity.
This project tries to find and fix weaknesses in old scientific software using binary analysis techniques.
This project redesigns neural networks so that they follow the rules of physics and can control self-driving cars and drones safely.
This project tries to find out when the motion of a fluid can be rebuilt accurately from the paths of small particles.
This project tries to find out how maize and other plants make pyridine nucleotides from the amino acids tryptophan or aspartate.
This project studies the foundations of positive geometry.
This project studies how plants, rainfall and ocean temperatures changed when the Mediterranean Sea dried up and then flooded again.
This project studies why deep networks can be fooled by small attacks and how to build networks that resist them.
This project holds a meeting where speakers discuss probability and stochastic processes.
This project studies how a plant, Arabidopsis thaliana, adapted as it spread to higher altitudes, using old herbarium samples and contemporary populations.
This project tries to find out whether hummingbird beaks are shaped by fighting as well as by feeding on flowers.
This project builds computer tools that predict how rare mutations affect peroxidases, a family of enzymes, and tests some effects in Drosophila.
This project builds an artificial intelligence tool that suggests how chemical reactions work in systems that turn carbon dioxide and water into fuels.
This project builds synthetic signaling systems in mammalian cells from proteins that were designed by computer and are not found in nature.
